|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |

| `is_pii` | `boolean` | Whether the field holds personal data. |
| `show_in_portal` | `boolean` | Whether the customer portal shows the field. |
| `position` | `integer` | The field's sort position; lower numbers come first. |
| `archived` | `boolean` | True if the field is archived. |
| `filter_kind` | `string` | The filter kind this field compares as. Use it to pick the value control; the field is filterable as `cf_<api_name>` on that entity's list. One of `text`, `enum`, `number`, `bool`, `date`. |
